metadata.question: Does the northern Pacific Ocean at an eastern location (48.504441, -137.527803) exhibit a higher sea surface temperature anomaly during January 1-31, 2016, compared to a western location (46.750838, -169.318365)? The anomaly is calculated against the baseline average from 2003 to 2012.

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define geometries
eastern_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-137.527803, 48.504441])
western_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-169.318365, 46.750838])

# 2. Load OISST data
oisst = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/OISST/AVHRR/v2')

# 3. Get baseline data (2003-2012)
baseline_col = oisst.filterDate('2003-01-01', '2012-12-31').select('sst')
baseline_size = baseline_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"Baseline collection (2003-2012): {baseline_size} images")

if baseline_size == 0:
    print("No baseline data found.")
    print("C1")
else:
    # Get January 2016 data
    jan_2016_col = oisst.filterDate('2016-01-01', '2016-01-31').select('sst')
    jan_2016_size = jan_2016_col.size().getInfo()
    print(f"January 2016 collection: {jan_2016_size} images")
    
    if jan_2016_size == 0:
        print("No January 2016 data found.")
        print("C1")
    else:
        # Calculate baseline mean for both locations
        baseline_mean_east = baseline_col.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
            geometry=eastern_point,
            scale=27830,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('sst_mean').getInfo()
        
        baseline_mean_west = baseline_col.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
            geometry=western_point,
            scale=27830,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('sst_mean').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Baseline SST - Eastern: {baseline_mean_east}, Western: {baseline_mean_west}")
        
        # Calculate January 2016 mean for both locations
        jan_2016_mean_east = jan_2016_col.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
            geometry=eastern_point,
            scale=27830,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('sst_mean').getInfo()
        
        jan_2016_mean_west = jan_2016_col.reduce(ee.Reducer.mean()).reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
            geometry=western_point,
            scale=27830,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('sst_mean').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Jan 2016 SST - Eastern: {jan_2016_mean_east}, Western: {jan_2016_mean_west}")
        
        # Validate data
        if (baseline_mean_east is None or baseline_mean_west is None or 
            jan_2016_mean_east is None or jan_2016_mean_west is None):
            print("No valid pixels for one or more locations.")
            print("C2")
        else:
            # Calculate anomalies
            anomaly_east = jan_2016_mean_east - baseline_mean_east
            anomaly_west = jan_2016_mean_west - baseline_mean_west
            
            print(f"Anomaly - Eastern: {anomaly_east:.2f}C, Western: {anomaly_west:.2f}C")
            
            # Compare
            if anomaly_east > anomaly_west:
                print("A")
            else:
                print("B")
